name: dialog_guard
description: Self-test for Patch_SuppressBlockingWindows. Raises the real two-field naming prompt that stranded indoor_glow_lamp.json, then runs a FastForward -- the step that CANNOT complete while a forcePause dialog is up, since it waits on a TicksGame target the paused clock never reaches. Reaching the end is the assertion; a broken guard hangs here, which is the right failure mode for a test of a hang. Also raises the message-box family, which the guard refuses rather than resolves.
